text:
Maria: FYI — customer A is pushing for EU+APAC staged rollout next quarter. Need a proposal for soft cutover + fast rollback. Thoughts? :eyes:
Alex: +1. We should define canary slices by region and by tenant size. small tenants first, then medium, then enterprise.
Sam: Ops constraint: peak GPU windows in APAC are tight. Recommend timeboxed ramp windows (02:00-06:00 UTC) and a traffic cap per minute.
Jordan: Telemetry gates we care about: p50/p95 latency, error rate, and token cost delta. If any gate trips -> immediate reroute to stable model.
Lisa: Can we add quality gate too? Use our eval prompt set (smoke prompts) and check BLEU-ish / embedding drift on a sample of 1k responses per hour.
Alex: Agree. Proposal sketch:
```
canary:
  slices:
    - region: eu
      tenants: small
      pct: 2
    - region: eu
      tenants: medium
      pct: 5
    - region: apac
      tenants: small
      pct: 1
  duration: 4h
  telemetry_gates:
    latency_p95: +30% allowed
    error_rate: 0.5% absolute
    quality_embed_cosine_diff: 0.02
fallback: route->model-stable-v1
rate_limit: 100 reqs/min per-tenant
```
Sam: That YAML looks good. Two asks: add token-budget-based shed: if cost-per-token > threshold for 10m, drop to cached responses or cheaper quantized variant.
Maria: Customer-driven ask: they want opt-in for enterprise tenants for first week. That means add a per-tenant opt-out flag and a manual override.
Alex: Implementation note: feature flag key = rollout.europe.q2.softcutover. Add param: allow_manual_override=true.
Jordan: Rollback ladder: 1) auto-fallback route (model-stable-v1), 2) set feature flag to 0 for region, 3) full cutover abort and traffic freeze. Each step should be instrumented by deploy-bot.
deploy-bot: @channel Canary started: rollout.europe.q2.softcutover slice=eu-small pct=2 start=1777012345
Lisa: For telemetry thresholds, suggest we use rolling 5m windows and require at least 3 consecutive windows violating before auto-fallback to reduce noise.
Sam: Ops note: allow a manual throttle knob for burst traffic (burst factor 2x for 10m) but with auto-expire. Also add conserved capacity for dedicated customers.
Maria: Launch criteria checklist draft:
- Canary run for 24h across eu small+medium with no gate trips
- Quality regressions < 0.5% on eval set
- Cost delta < 12% week-over-week forecast impact
- Ops runbook reviewed and signed by SRE
- Customer opt-ins processed and docs updated
Alex: Timeline: implement flag + routing + telemetry hooks (2 sprints), run internal shadow for 1 week, then staged canary next sprint.
Jordan: One more: ensure fallback model binary compatibility for payloads (function-calling payloads included). Add contract tests.
Maria: Customer communications: email + in-console banner 48h before, and a rollback SLA note. Sam can you draft the ops runbook?
Sam: I'll draft it. Will include kill-switch steps and command snippets. Example: `curl -X POST https://api.internal/flags/rollout.europe.q2.softcutover -d '{"value":0}'`
Lisa: I'll prepare the eval set and run synthetic drift tests during shadow.
Alex: I'll own the feature flag implementation and the model routing.
Maria: Great. Can everyone add their blockers to the doc by EOD Friday? We'll sync Mon to finalize gating numbers. :thumbsup:
Jordan: noted.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: latency_p95=158ms (+12%), error_rate=0.12%, embed_drift=0.008 — monitoring
Sam: Early metrics look healthy. Keeping an eye on APAC window.
Maria: Thanks all — this helps. We want the soft cutover to be reversible and cheap to roll back. Meeting to finalize Monday 10am UTC.
